title: The ICN-UN Battery: A Machine Learning-Optimized Tool for Expeditious Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis.
summary: A machine-learning-optimized neuropsychological battery distinguished clinically labeled Alzheimer’s cases from controls in a 760-person cohort while reducing the assessment time in the reported internal evaluation. The result is reported in Diagnostics. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
organization: Instituto Colombiano de Neuropedagogía; Universidad de La Costa; Grupo Internacional de Investigación Neuro-Conductual (GIINCO)

evidence.tested: A machine-learning-optimized neuropsychological battery distinguished clinically labeled Alzheimer’s cases from controls in a 760-person cohort while reducing the assessment time in the reported internal evaluation.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and prospective real-world benefit are not established in the reviewed study.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
